title: Kony My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible en nono ne ji duto, nyaka chieng’. Ka konyi, inyalo konyo mondo taa osik kamaliel.
lead: Som, lam, pog, kendo tim kamano kendo.
sub: Nono ne ji duto, nyaka chieng’. Ka konyi, inyalo konyo mondo taa osik kamaliel.
kofiSub: Dichiel, kata dwe ka dwe. Gi kad, Apple Pay kata Google Pay, ok idwar ndiko nyingi.
leave: Yawore e wech manyien. Dog ka, kata e Muma, ka isetieko.
btcSub: On-chain kata Lightning, tir e server marwa wawegi, maonge jadiere kata ng’at machielo.
btcAddressQr: QR code mar address mar Bitcoin
where:
• Servers ma miyo riwo kod kanyakla dhi nyime tiyo.
  • Nyinge mag domain, mondo myquietbible.com odhi nyime tiyo.
  • Email ma oro kode mag donjo.
never: Onge gimoro e Muma ma biro lor ngang’. Chiwo en goyo erokamano, ok en tiket mar donjo, kendo onge gima lokore e app kata ka ichiwo kata ok ichiw.
tax: My Quiet Bible ok en riwruok mar kony mondiki e sirkal, omiyo mich ok nyal dwok piny osuru mari.
other:
• Lam ne tijni, kod ne ji ma somo kode.
  • Or myquietbible.com ne ng’at ma dwaro Muma mamuol.
